method: independent rational arithmetic and explicit state/population rules

derivations.metric-09: Subtract signing completion from each actual endpoint; root span end is not signing
derivations.metric-10: Minimum peer observation in each declared population relative to slot start
derivations.metric-11: Use actual write, excluding the earlier API/enqueue timestamp
derivations.metric-12: Each decode uses the common range request start; slots 1 and 5 contain two blocks
derivations.metric-13: Subtract actual decode completion, not pre-decode receipt
derivations.metric-14: Nearest rank uses all four eligible nodes; rank three is censored, not renormalized
derivations.metric-15: (14-10)/2 * 100; RSS and current OS threads are gauges
derivations.metric-16: Count successful completed local writes only
derivations.metric-18: Observe live bytes only on a major-count increment after the initial baseline; no Go major/minor substitution
derivations.metric-19: The common specification counts only newly added transactions as accepted: 2. Of 4 submitted, one duplicate and one validation failure are not added: rejected=4-2=2. Three native nil returns do not imply three new admissions.
derivations.metric-20: 2 / 4 with aligned submitted/newly-admitted populations; duplicates count among transactions not added
derivations.metric-21: (14-10)/4 in the same window; whole-node index, not isolated validation CPU
derivations.metric-22: Use atomic post-mutation common CBOR byte snapshots; duplicates do not grow occupancy
derivations.metric-23: Rollback publishes a new generation; each count/density pair is same-state

derivations.peer-normalization: Convert each source occurrence to nine-digit UTC without sorting publication sequence; preserve full point, session and request identities; both peers saw the same block, so the block population is one and the peer population is two; occurrence order is the reverse of serialization order.
derivations.intake-count-mismatch: The collected population must be the four transactions actually submitted, not the three in the last transport reply; per-batch subtraction on those mismatched populations is invalid.
